description: This test file contains unit tests for the authentication and route checking functionalities of the litellm proxy project, specifically testing functions like get_api_key, team metadata propagation, route classification, and cache expiration handling within auth mechanisms.

classes.name: LiteLLM_TeamTable
classes.description: A data model representing a team, including metadata like tags, department, and model limits.

classes.name: UserAPIKeyAuth
classes.description: Represents an authenticated user's API key information, including team metadata, roles, and expiration details.

methods.name: test_get_api_key()
methods.description: Tests the get_api_key function with a standard Bearer token

methods.name: test_get_api_key_with_custom_litellm_key_header( custom_litellm_key_header, api_key, passed_in_key )
methods.description: Tests get_api_key handling custom key headers with various prefixes and formats

methods.name: test_team_metadata_with_tags_flows_through_jwt_auth()
methods.description: Verifies that team metadata, especially tags, are correctly propagated into UserAPIKeyAuth instances

methods.name: test_route_checks_is_llm_api_route()
methods.description: Validates route classification logic for various known LLM and passthrough routes

methods.name: test_proxy_admin_expired_key_from_cache()
methods.description: Regression test ensuring that expired cache entries for admin keys are correctly identified and handled, including cache removal
